rules.name: recon-risk-01-release-deployed
rules.sql: SELECT id, author, exectype, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id IN ('fn_deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_source-v3', 'recon_materialize_settle-v3', 'recon_postprocess_settle-v2', 'recon_postprocess_actual-v2', 'recon_postprocess_settle-v3', 'recon_postprocess_actual-v3', 'recon_materialize_traders-v3-bu-join', 'fn_input_security_traders_value_source_v1-v2-bu-join', 'create-idx-usv-tenant-lower-underlying-valdate') ORDER BY dateexecuted

SELECT w.id AS missing_or_bad, coalesce(d.exectype, 'NOT IN databasechangelog') AS status FROM (VALUES ('fn_deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_source-v3'), ('recon_materialize_settle-v3'), ('recon_postprocess_settle-v2'), ('recon_postprocess_actual-v2'), ('recon_postprocess_settle-v3'), ('recon_postprocess_actual-v3'), ('recon_materialize_traders-v3-bu-join'), ('fn_input_security_traders_value_source_v1-v2-bu-join'), ('create-idx-usv-tenant-lower-underlying-valdate')) AS w(id) LEFT JOIN opera.databasechangelog d ON d.id = w.id WHERE d.id IS NULL OR d.exectype <> 'EXECUTED'

SELECT ic.relname AS index_name, i.indisvalid, i.indisready, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS definition FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE ic.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND ic.relname = 'idx_usv_tenant_lower_underlying_valdate'

SELECT p.proname, (p.prosrc ILIKE '%futures_price_table%')::int AS reads_futures_price_table, (p.prosrc ILIKE '%recon_futures_price_input%')::int AS reads_old_futures_input, (p.prosrc ILIKE '%upper(trim(m.portfolio))%')::int AS mapping_case_insensitive, (p.prosrc ILIKE '%h_p = ''B''%')::int AS default_h_p_b FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('recon_materialize_settle', 'recon_postprocess_settle', 'recon_postprocess_actual') ORDER BY p.proname

expect.reason: all nine changesets of the release are recorded
none is missing or in a state other than EXECUTED
a concurrent build that failed leaves an invalid index
settle materializer and the two post processors exist
no recon function still reads recon_futures_price_input
XOGA-710 text is live in the settle materializer
both post processors match the mapping with upper(trim())
both post processors keep h_p = B for unmapped rows
